corpus.note: DEPRECATED (todo:697f9e58) — superseded by the per-work golden set (golden-queries.test.ts). Frozen legacy, not re-baselined past v37. Domain-knowledge regression labels pinned to this corpus snapshot (todo:b22586bc, design §9.3). Two assertion kinds, neither circular: (1) tradition-anchored queries use a distinctive term whose tradition a comparative-religion reader would assert regardless of the system — recall is 'did the expected tradition survive into top-K'; (2) hierarchy queries assert the query plane engages (minConcepts) + breadth (minTraditions). These are NOT chunk-level relevance judgments — those need human ratification (follow-up). Re-baseline deliberately when corpus_version changes; do not let it silently rot. Re-baselined 2026-07-09 at the v4 document-knowledge deploy (todo:8673c77e): all v27 labels re-verified against the V8-cleaned re-embedded corpus; 13/14 held unchanged.

The modern 'sefirot' spelling misses top-15 despite a concept_aliases entry — graph-leg transliteration hits lose slots to vector hubs (GRAPH_WEIGHT tuning, see todo:31a7fe76). Domain-true either way; the gate pins the spelling the corpus can currently defend.

knownGaps.note: Recorded, NOT asserted — these would make the baseline perpetually red. Distinctive in-corpus terms whose (small / commentary-heavy) tradition does NOT survive into top-K under current vector+graph retrieval at corpus v27. Captured as todo for investigation; promote to asserted queries once retrieval surfaces them.

cases.query: the One and emanation from the Nous
cases.reason: corpus drift v37->v63: the modern-synthesis omnibus texts (secret-teachings-of-all-ages, blavatsky-sd) that discuss 'the One'/'Nous' in clean modern prose out-rank Plotinus's archaic translation, and 'Nous' renders as 'Mind' in-text. Moved to knownGaps when this file was deprecated (todo:697f9e58); it fails identically with graph ranking on or off, so it is a pre-existing vector-side gap, not a ranking regression.
